Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1(A.1),(A.2),(A.7) and Appendix A.2. The explicit Borel complete-history append and its restricted next-history transport are attributed ASTIS completion of one iteration ingredient, not a printed standalone theorem. Full A.7 remains open.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Define W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Define ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. Write A_n(h,s) for the complete history obtained by preserving every old coordinate h_j and appending live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and appending stopped when h_n=stopped. Put L_n(h,s)=(A_n(h,s),s). Negative real times use the displayed raw-real harmonic flow with a clipped cumulative increment; this and the stopped branch are auxiliary totalizations, with actual positive finite jump identification only on the guard below. H_(n+1), A_n and L_n are Borel, and A_n(h,s)_j=h_j for every old index0≤j≤n and every abstract(h,s). For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each value finite but with no uniform bound, define D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s), B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), Y_n(w)=(H_(n+1)(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)) and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗real Lebesgue). B_d and Y_n are Borel. For every w∈B_d, H_(n+1)(w)=A_n(X_n(w)), preserving the actual old records and appending exactly the actual cumulative next time and post-bounce state. The actual restricted laws satisfy (Y_n)_*(P|B_d)=(L_n)_*ν_d and (H_(n+1))_*(P|B_d)=(A_n)_*ν_d, and ((L_n)_*ν_d)(Hist_(n+1)×ℝ)≤1. These are restricted finite-component laws; no unrestricted next-history law is asserted. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the function h↦∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness/integrability hypothesis on F, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, constructor-law or measurability provider is assumed. The cases n=0, d=0, null A, stopped/infinite waits, zero hazard/normal, rank zero and unrealizable histories are included; infinite waits and zero/cutoff endpoints fail the strict guard, without an atom-equivalence assertion. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one actual complete-history extension ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), using the already verified conditional finite-density law. Ordered absolute-time iteration, final survival/path-factor assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual restart/Markovness, global conclusions, implementation/error/unbounded cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN. Survival88 and a separate no-atom theorem are not proof prerequisites.

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
    let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
            Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
      let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
      let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
      let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
      let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
      let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
      let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
      let append : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
        Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
          | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl (a.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
              S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 a.2))
          | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
      let lift : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (append p, p.2)
      Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable append ∧ Measurable lift ∧
      (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), append p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧
      (∀ d : Hist → ℝ≥0, Measurable d →
        let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
        let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h s =>
          if 0 < s ∧ s < (d h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, s) else 0
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
        let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w =>
          (H w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext × ℝ := fun w =>
          (Hnext w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
        MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable Y ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, Hnext w = append (X w)) ∧
        Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map lift ν ∧
        Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map append ν ∧
        (Measure.map lift ν) Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ F : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (lift (h, s)) * D h s) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, F (lift (h, s)) * D h s) ∂μ)))

Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product normed additive commutative group, with its Borel measurable space. Dimension zero is permitted. Let V:E→R be twice continuously Frechet differentiable. Let alpha,beta be nonnegative real numbers and eta a real number. Assume alpha>0, alpha≤beta, eta>0, beta*eta≤1, and, for every x,v∈E,
  alpha*||v||² ≤ (D(DV)(x)[v])[v] ≤ beta*||v||².
Here every occurrence of alpha and beta in a real expression uses its real coercion. These are the analytic assumptions; the process, observations, and density below are literal definitions.

For arbitrary y,xRef∈E define c(y,xRef)=y−eta*grad V(xRef). For every real t and phase state z=(x,v)∈E×E define
  Phi(y,xRef,t,(x,v))=(c+cos(t)*(x−c)+sqrt(eta)*sin(t)*v,
                         −sin(t)/sqrt(eta)*(x−c)+cos(t)*v).
All products with vectors here denote real scalar multiplication. Define g(x,xRef)=grad V(x)−grad V(xRef), and
  S(xRef,(x,v))=(x, v−[2*<v,g(x,xRef)>/||g(x,xRef)||²]*g(x,xRef)),
  rate(xRef,(x,v))=sqrt(eta)*max(0,<v,g(x,xRef)>).
The abbreviation g only expands the displayed gradient difference. Real division is total: division by zero gives zero. In particular S leaves (x,v) unchanged when the gradient difference vanishes. Eta>0 makes sqrt(eta)>0.

For t∈R_{≥0}, put
  Lambda(y,xRef,z,t)=integral from 0 to the real value of t of rate(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,s,z)) ds,
where this is the displayed real Bochner interval integral. For each threshold e∈R_{≥0}, put
  tau(y,xRef,z,e)=inf{t∈R_{≥0}: Lambda(y,xRef,z,t)−e≥0},
with values in R_{≥0}∪{infinity}; an empty entry-time set has infimum infinity under the stipulated hittingAfter convention. This expands hittingAfter of the function (t,a)↦Lambda(a.1.1,a.1.2,a.2.1,t)−a.2.2 against the target [0,infinity), starting at time 0 and parameter a=((y,xRef),z,e). The parameter product associates to the right. No strictly positive threshold is imposed in this definition. Write finite0(u)=u if u is finite and finite0(infinity)=0.

Let Rec=(R_{≥0}×(E×E)) disjoint-union Unit. Write active(T,z) for its left tag and stopped for its right singleton tag. For every threshold e define
  next(y,xRef,e,stopped)=stopped;
  next(y,xRef,e,active(T,z))=stopped if tau(y,xRef,z,e)=infinity;
  next(y,xRef,e,active(T,z))=active(T+finite0(tau), S(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,real(finite0(tau)),z))) otherwise.
For any threshold sequence e:N→R_{≥0}, any initial phase state z0, and any n∈N, define r0=active(0,z0) and r(k+1)=next(y,xRef,e(k),r(k)); record(y,xRef,z0,e,n)=rn. This is finite recursion only, with stopped absorbing. It does not prescribe an extra rule for infinitely many events accumulating in finite elapsed time.

Let W=R^N and P be the canonical countable product of rate-one exponential laws on R. Define epsilon(w,k)=max(w(k),0), represented as a nonnegative real. For every m∈N define history(y,xRef,z0,m,w) to be the (m+1)-tuple whose j-th coordinate is record(y,xRef,z0,epsilon(w),j), for j=0,...,m.

For q=(r,s)∈Rec×R define three observations, with all tags and defaults retained:
  waitObs(y,xRef,(active(T,z),s))=tau(y,xRef,z,max(s,0));
  waitObs(y,xRef,(stopped,s))=0;
  timeObs(y,xRef,q)=real(finite0(waitObs(y,xRef,q)));
  density(y,xRef,(active(T,z),s))=ofReal(rate(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,s,z))*exp(−Lambda(y,xRef,z,max(s,0))));
  density(y,xRef,(stopped,s))=0.
Here ofReal(a) is max(a,0) embedded in the extended nonnegative reals. The elapsed time T is not used in these three observations. In density the flow uses the original real s, while the cumulative-hazard argument uses max(s,0). A stopped observation has time 0; an infinite wait also has timeObs 0 even though next then produces stopped. A finite zero wait has timeObs 0 and next follows its finite branch. Negative real coordinates are clamped only at the explicitly displayed max operations.

For every y,xRef∈E, every z0∈E×E, and every n∈N, make the following definitions. Hist=Rec^{0,...,n}, HistNext=Rec^{0,...,n+1}, and last=n. H(w)=history(y,xRef,z0,n,w); Hnext(w)=history(y,xRef,z0,n+1,w). Define append:Hist×R→HistNext by retaining all old coordinates and appending to h the following record:
  active(T+max(s,0), S(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,s,z))) if h(last)=active(T,z);
  stopped if h(last)=stopped.
Define lift(h,s)=(append(h,s),s)∈HistNext×R. The definition of append is total for all h and all real s, without requiring h to be a realizable history or s to be nonnegative. At negative s it adds zero to elapsed time while evaluating Phi at that negative s; it has no tau=infinity test. It appends the stopped tag when the last input record is stopped.

The first conclusions are: Hnext, append, and lift are Borel measurable; and for every p=(h,s)∈Hist×R and every j=0,...,n,
  append(p)(j)=h(j),
where the old finite index is embedded in the larger tuple without changing its value.

Further, for every Borel measurable d:Hist→R_{≥0}, with no continuity or deterministic-constant requirement, put mu=H_*P and define D:Hist×R→[0,infinity] by
  D(h,s)=density(y,xRef,(h(last),s)) if 0<s and s<real(d(h));
  D(h,s)=0 otherwise.
Thus on the nonzero branch h(last) must be active to contribute, and the explicit active formula there is
  ofReal(rate(xRef,Phi(y,xRef,s,z))*exp(−Lambda(y,xRef,z,s)))
for h(last)=active(T,z) and 0<s<d(h); on this branch s is nonnegative so max(s,0)=s. D vanishes for stopped records, nonpositive s, s=d(h), and s>d(h). Its guarded definition still uses the original, explicitly total density outside any inferred probability support.

For w∈W define r=record(y,xRef,z0,epsilon(w),n)=H(w)(last) and u=waitObs(y,xRef,(r,w(n))). Set
  B={w: 0<u<d(H(w))},
where both comparisons are in R_{≥0}∪{infinity} and the finite nonnegative cap is embedded in that ordered space. Set
  X(w)=(H(w),timeObs(y,xRef,(r,w(n))));
  Y(w)=(Hnext(w),timeObs(y,xRef,(r,w(n))));
  nu=(mu product Lebesgue_measure_on_R) with density (h,s)↦D(h,s).
This is the unnormalized density measure. P restricted to B is also unnormalized. The strict guard excludes stopped states, zero waits, infinite waits, and finite waits at or beyond the cap. When d(H(w))=0 the event cannot hold. No restriction of F to bounded functions, and no normalization by P(B), occurs.

For each such measurable cap d the theorem concludes all of the following:
  (1) B is measurable and Y is Borel measurable on all W.
  (2) For every w∈B, Hnext(w)=append(X(w)).
  (3) Y_*(P restricted to B)=lift_*nu, as measures on HistNext×R.
  (4) Hnext_*(P restricted to B)=append_*nu, as measures on HistNext.
  (5) (lift_*nu)(HistNext×R)≤1.
  (6) For every jointly Borel measurable test F:HistNext×R→[0,infinity], the function
        h↦integral over s∈R of F(lift(h,s))*D(h,s) ds
      is Borel measurable. Moreover, for every Borel measurable A⊆Hist,
        integral over w∈B intersect H^{-1}(A) of F(Y(w)) dP(w)
          = integral over h∈A of [integral over s∈R of F(lift(h,s))*D(h,s) ds] dmu(h).
All integrals in (6) are extended nonnegative Lebesgue integrals, so no integrability premise is added and either side may take the value infinity. The Borel requirement on F is joint in the entire next-history/time pair, rather than merely a separate measurability claim. A ranges over the whole finite-history space, not just the last record. The same y,xRef,z0,n and cap d are fixed throughout (1)–(6).

The statement concerns every finite history length and its next update with a history-dependent strict waiting-time cap. It asserts neither a law on an infinite accumulated trajectory nor a full unconditional density at zero or infinity. No source-fidelity verdict is part of this reconstruction.

    hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη

  let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
  let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
  let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
  let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)

      | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl (a.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
          S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 a.2))
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
  let lift : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (append p, p.2)

    (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), append p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧ _
  -- Borel actual histories and the source's zero-safe flow/reflection constructor.

  have hHnext : Measurable Hnext := (hhistory y xRef z₀ (n + 1)).1

    | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()

      hbounce.1.comp ((measurable_const : Measurable
        (fun _ : (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) × ℝ => xRef)).prodMk hφ)

        (Sum.inl (q.1.1 + Real.toNNReal q.2, S xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 q.1.2)) : Rec)) :=
      measurable_inl.comp ((measurable_fst.fst.add

lesson.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Define W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Define ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z)exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. Write A_n(h,s) for the complete history obtained by preserving every old coordinate h_j and appending live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and appending stopped when h_n=stopped. Put L_n(h,s)=(A_n(h,s),s). Negative real times use the displayed raw-real harmonic flow with a clipped cumulative increment; this and the stopped branch are auxiliary totalizations, with actual positive finite jump identification only on the guard below. H_(n+1), A_n and L_n are Borel, and A_n(h,s)_j=h_j for every old index0≤j≤n and every abstract(h,s). For every fixed Borel d:Hist_n→[0,∞), each value finite but with no uniform bound, define D_d(h,s)=1_{0<s<d(h)}ρ(h_n,s), B_d={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))}, X_n(w)=(H_n(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)), Y_n(w)=(H_(n+1)(w),t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)) and ν_d=D_d(μ_n⊗real Lebesgue). B_d and Y_n are Borel. For every w∈B_d, H_(n+1)(w)=A_n(X_n(w)), preserving the actual old records and appending exactly the actual cumulative next time and post-bounce state. The actual restricted laws satisfy (Y_n)_*(P|B_d)=(L_n)_*ν_d and (H_(n+1))_*(P|B_d)=(A_n)_*ν_d, and ((L_n)_*ν_d)(Hist_(n+1)×ℝ)≤1. These are restricted finite-component laws; no unrestricted next-history law is asserted. For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the function h↦∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds is Borel. For every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B_d∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y_n(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫_ℝF(L_n(h,s))D_d(h,s)ds]μ_n(dh). No boundedness/integrability hypothesis on F, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, constructor-law or measurability provider is assumed. The cases n=0, d=0, null A, stopped/infinite waits, zero hazard/normal, rank zero and unrealizable histories are included; infinite waits and zero/cutoff endpoints fail the strict guard, without an atom-equivalence assertion. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one actual complete-history extension ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), using the already verified conditional finite-density law. Ordered absolute-time iteration, final survival/path-factor assembly, full(A.7), physical-time residual restart/Markovness, global conclusions, implementation/error/unbounded cost/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN.
